_comment: Ground truth schema for Resume Explorer evaluation. Fill in one file per resume version.
_instructions: Copy this file to resume_v1_gt.json (and resume_v2_gt.json for multi-doc tests).
Fill in the values based on what the resume actually contains.
skills: canonical labels (after normalization). Include all distinct technical and soft skills.
jobs: each entry needs at least title and org. start_year is optional but helps test date handling.
organizations: distinct org names (normalized form you expect after dedup).
education: include degree abbreviation (e.g. 'MS', 'BS', 'PhD') and field.
certifications: list of cert titles as they should appear after normalization.
expected_*_min: minimum count of that entity type you expect to be extracted.
expected_*_max: maximum acceptable count (catches over-extraction / hallucination).

person.name: FILL IN — exact name as it appears on the resume

skills: FILL IN — one canonical skill label per entry

jobs.title: FILL IN — job title as you expect it extracted

education.degree: FILL IN — e.g. MS, BS, PhD
